text.section: This article shall apply to all benefit corporations.

The existence of a provision of this article shall not of itself create an implication that a contrary or different rule of law applies to a corporation organized pursuant to the provisions of this chapter that is not a benefit corporation. This article shall not affect a statute or rule of law that applies to a corporation that is not a benefit corporation.
The specific provisions of this article shall control over the general provisions of other articles of this chapter.
